mapper.sql: l.id, l.title, l.leave_type, l.start_date, l.end_date, l.reason, l.apply_user, l.approver, l.create_time, p.approval_id, CAST(CASE WHEN p.create_result = 2 THEN 4 ELSE IFNULL(p.approval_status, 0) END AS CHAR) AS status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_leave l LEFT JOIN approval_projection p ON p.business_type = #{businessType} AND p.business_key = CAST(l.id AS CHAR) WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_leave (id, title, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, apply_user, approver, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{leaveType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason}, #{applyUser}, #{approver}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
